verdict.rationale: Linear's Loops feature lets users describe a job in plain language and choose whether it runs on a schedule or in response to an event, plus webhooks and automation triggers (e.g., new issue reported triggers Agent investigation, subscribe to project view events). This directly matches rule-based, event-triggered automation. Missing for 10: detailed conditional-logic/rule-builder documentation and independent/hands-on verification of complex event-trigger reliability beyond vendor changelog claims.
